scope: Harness progress-ledger validation, not SDK behavior
summary: An accidental extra `},{` in docs/progress.json made the A05 missing list invalid JSON. The progress runner reported SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}', so 8 ledger-validation cases failed; unrelated tests passed (30/38 total passed).
recovery: Removed the stray delimiter. The corrected full unit suite then passed 38/38 at 2026-10-03T20:08:12.363Z, and the subsequent `npm run progress` and `npm run check` passed.
failedRunArtifact: The runner's artifacts/unit/latest.json was overwritten by the corrected passing rerun; this sanitized evidence preserves the failure summary and test counts.
explicitNonClaims: This failure did not involve SDK behavior or backend tests.
No test normalizer or progress claim was used to hide it.
